request_text: Fix the concrete WP10 cold-project shared-parent composition gap reported in wp10-handoff.md through a bounded owner Op. Retained managed_skills and command_skills both claim .agents and .agents/skills, causing cross-owner effect conflict; existing-parent managed-first schedule also invalidates command ancestor observations. Supply correct shared-directory ownership/execution and supported order while preserving strict original paired/command preflight, retained bytes/observations/consent, exact effects, single physical writes, and stale-input refusal. Distinguish consumer scheduling from real owner API gaps. No generic transaction/VFS, blanket mtime bypass, reassessment, or duplicate-effect report-only suppression. Independent review and actual WP10 consumer follow-through required; preserve approved provisioning semantics and unrelated dependencies.
